name: leaky integral control in a growing cell (type II, eps = 1; control)
question: Does the output return to its set point after a step of the input, and through which variable?

provenance.source: Qian and Del Vecchio, J. R. Soc. Interface 15, 20170902 (2018), doi:10.1098/rsif.2017.0902: type II quasi-integral controller, Eq. (2.7), with the process of Fig. 1; parameters of Fig. 1d

assumptions: concentrations in nM, time in hours
dilution of every controller species at the growth rate gamma
the step of the source: the disturbance d from 0 to 5 nM/h (Fig. 1d)
observable: protein concentration x relative to the set point u

regulation.change: controller reactions as slow as in the leaky controller of Eq. (2.4): eps = 1
